# Tremplin

Tremplin is Devciel's unreleased frontend framework.
Current package version: 0.8.0-beta.0. Use metadata/api.json and
metadata/public-api.json for the current public contracts. Contributor source
verification and provenance are documented in docs/SOURCE_STRUCTURE.md.
Original code and documentation credits are retained in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.
Do not claim support for unverified versions or dependencies.

Use current local dist assets or a locally packed tarball until publication is
approved and the exact release is verified. All public browser JavaScript files
are native ES modules: load them with type="module". They do not create a public
global. Import named exports from tremplin, or the default plugin export from a
component subpath. The bundle includes Floating UI and Vanilla Calendar Pro;
standard builds require those peers to be resolved.

Getting started routes (relative to the documentation origin):
- /getting-started/: first working HTML page and learning path
- /getting-started/install/: local assets, tarball, package and CDN caveats
- /getting-started/ai/: coding-assistant context and verification
- /getting-started/approach/: current markup and conventions
- /getting-started/css-variables/: runtime component tokens
- /getting-started/javascript/: imports, data API, events, cleanup and CSP
- /getting-started/browsers-devices/: targets and testing limitations
- /getting-started/accessibility/: author responsibilities and manual checks
- /getting-started/download/: built assets and integrity verification
- /getting-started/contents/: formats, exports, declarations and source files
- /getting-started/bundlers/: application build and Sass integration
- /getting-started/rtl/: direction, logical properties and mixed text

No Tremplin agent-skills package or llms-full.txt is provided.
No retired documentation version or compatibility runtime is maintained.

- Current migration guidance: docs/MIGRATION.md
- Product plan: docs/PRODUCT_PLAN.md
- Feature status: docs/FEATURES.md
- Strict API policy: docs/API_STABILITY.md
- Actual component options and methods: metadata/api.json
- Public package/CSS/Sass contract: metadata/public-api.json
- Documentation source: site/src/pages and site/src/data
- Documentation build: site-dist (generated with npm run build:site)
- Repository tooling: build/
- JavaScript source: src/js/
- Sass source: src/scss/
- Distribution: dist/ (tracked and rebuilt)
- CSS classes: container, grid, md:col-6, btn-solid, theme-primary, card
- CSS custom-property prefix: --trm-
- JavaScript data-hook prefix: data-trm-
- Starters: starters/ (broader qualification remains pending)
- Icons: icons/tremplin-icons.svg
- Optional themes: themes/
